I replied to Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message. The only deadline anyone has given for Tansley Parcel's signed order form is 25 August. Pree posted it in #central-team on 14 October, so everyone in that channel could already see it.

I warned him that the date hadn't been confirmed. 25 August had already passed when Pree posted it, and she hasn't answered my question about whether it's right. There are also no Tansley Parcel files in the share I can check it against.

I suggested he check with Pree before he puts the date in the account sheet. I didn't change anything else.
